June 7, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Churchill Management Corp increased its stake in Applied Materials Inc (AMAT) by 24.04% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Churchill Management Corp bought 9,221 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.54% with the market. The institutional investor held 47,576 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.65 million, up from 38,355 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Churchill Management Corp who had been investing in Applied Materials Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $52.95 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.72% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $52.53. About 8.68 million shares traded. Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMAT) has risen 12.95% since June 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.38% the S&P500.
